InvalidInput.Cause: Authorize both text generations and choose exactly one of prior_run_id or no_prior_state=true.

StageInvocationFailed.Cause: Preparation, retrieval, or validation failed. Inspect saved evidence before recovery.

UnexpectedStageResult.Cause: A stage returned an unexpected result or identity.

SubmissionOutcomeUncertain.Cause: Submission did not return confirmed preservation. Do not automatically resubmit.

ExistingSubmissionClaim.Cause: An existing submission claim blocked this execution. Inspect recovery evidence; do not assume success.

GenerationUnsuccessful.Cause: Generation failed, was cancelled, or was incomplete. No automatic resubmission.

PollingLimitReached.Cause: Polling stopped after the configured limit. The remote generation may still be running.

AudioFailedWorkerStoppedOwnershipRetaine.Cause: Worker observed stopped after audio failure. Ownership retained; reconcile outstanding commands. Original failure: $.audio_failure.

AudioShutdownDeadlineExceeded.Cause: Shutdown observation limit reached. Ownership retained. Inspect $.audio_failure and saved request evidence.

AudioCleanupUnresolved.Cause: Cleanup failed or returned unexpected evidence. Ownership retained. Inspect $.audio_failure and $.audio_cleanup_error.

AudioStartupOutcomeUnresolved.Cause: EC2 startup outcome unresolved. Do not restart, stop, or release automatically. Reconcile $.audio_failure and saved startup evidence.

AudioOwnershipUnresolved.Cause: Worker busy or ownership uncertain. Inspect evidence; do not start or release.

AudioFailedAfterCleanup.Cause: Audio failed; worker stopped and ownership released. Inspect $.audio_failure.

WorkflowWorkDeadlineExceeded.Cause: Shared work deadline reached before EC2 startup. No further work is submitted.

WorkflowWorkDeadlineOwnershipRetained.Cause: Shared work deadline reached before EC2 startup. Ownership retained for review.

WorkflowCleanupDeadlineExceeded.Cause: Shared one-hour deadline reached. Ownership retained; inspect shutdown evidence.
